stem:
Yuvraj checks whether $5824$ is divisible by $4$ by testing one digit block of $5824$.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Test whether $58$, formed by the first two digits, is divisible by $4$.
Test whether $4$ is divisible by $24$, the number formed by the last two digits.
Test whether $24$, formed by the last two digits, is divisible by $4$.
Test whether $824$, formed by the last three digits, is divisible by $4$.

teacher.key_rationale: Only the last two digits matter: 24÷4=6, so 5824 is divisible by 4. First-two digits, reversing the test, or last-three digits are the wrong block or wrong direction.
